columns.name: Sex
columns.description: The patient's biological sex: F for female and M for male.

columns.name: ChestPainType
columns.description: The type of chest pain: ASY for asymptomatic, ATA for atypical angina, NAP for non-anginal pain, and TA for typical angina.

columns.name: RestingBP
columns.description: The patient's resting blood pressure in millimeters of mercury (mm Hg).

columns.name: Cholesterol
columns.description: The patient's serum cholesterol level in milligrams per deciliter (mg/dL).

columns.name: FastingBS
columns.description: Indicates whether fasting blood sugar exceeds 120 mg/dL: 1 means yes and 0 means no.

columns.name: RestingECG
columns.description: The resting electrocardiogram result: LVH indicates left ventricular hypertrophy, Normal indicates no abnormality, and ST indicates an ST-T wave abnormality.

columns.name: MaxHR
columns.description: The maximum heart rate achieved during exercise.

columns.name: ExerciseAngina
columns.description: Indicates whether exercise induced angina: Y means yes and N means no.

columns.name: Oldpeak
columns.description: The ST-segment depression induced by exercise relative to rest.

columns.name: ST_Slope
columns.description: The slope of the peak exercise ST segment: Down, Flat, or Up.

columns.name: HeartDisease
columns.description: The target classification label: 1 indicates the presence of heart disease and 0 indicates no heart disease.
